# Processed Data

This directory contains cleaned, preprocessed, and feature-engineered data ready for model training.

## Files (generated by pipeline)

| File | Description | Generated by |
|------|-------------|-------------|
| `features.csv` | Tabular env. features (SST, Chl-a, turbidity, wind, HAB label) | `notebooks/02_feature_engineering.ipynb` |
| `features_train.csv` | Training split | preprocessing script |
| `features_val.csv` | Validation split | preprocessing script |
| `features_test.csv` | Test split | preprocessing script |
| `climatology_chl.nc` | Chlorophyll-a climatological baseline | preprocessing script |
| `climatology_sst.nc` | SST climatological baseline | preprocessing script |

## Column Schema (features.csv)

```
date, lat, lon, sst, sst_anomaly, chl_a, chl_anomaly, turbidity,
wind_speed, wind_dir, current_speed, hab_occurrence_7d,
hab_label (0=no HAB, 1=HAB)
```
